opportunities.title: PEC-PG Graduate Exchange Program 2027-28 (Brazil)
opportunities.provider: Brazil Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MRE) + CNPq / CAPES
opportunities.funding: R$2,100/month for 24 months + public health cover + return travel; public universities tuition-free
opportunities.notes: Kept for a later cycle — NOT a Sep 2027 entry. PEC-PG 2027 (Brazil, MRE + CNPq/CAPES): up to 100 master's scholarships; Pakistan is a partner country (NDU Islamabad circulated the 2027-28 notice; confirm Pakistan on the official call-notice country list). LANGUAGE — checked 22 Nov 2026 on official pages: PEC-PG sets NO language rule itself — language is each programme's own rule (official MRE selection-process page). UNICAMP Energy Systems Planning (direct energy fit, School of Mechanical Engineering) asks for NO Portuguese certificate in its official call, and accepts a Declaration of Expected Graduation Date instead of a diploma — BUT its classes, entrance exam (dissertation test) and interview run in Portuguese in practice, and the 'English-taught' label comes from a secondary listing only, not the official call. So Portuguese is a practical requirement, not a paper one. ELIGIBILITY: PEC-PG requires a COMPLETED undergraduate degree (official MRE page) — he graduates Jul 2027, so only a Feb/Mar 2028 start works. TIMELINE: final HEI list Dec 2026; universities select candidates Dec 2026–Mar 2028; scholarships must start paying by Mar 2028. UNICAMP PSE runs two calls a year (1st-semester call ~Oct, 2nd-semester call ~Apr–May by pattern — both unverified for 2027/28, do not plan on them); realistic target is the 2028-1S call (~Oct 2027) for a Feb 2028 start. PSE selection needs a potential advisor contacted FIRST (nomination phase), 10 vacancies total for master's + doctorate, and GRE is mandatory for scholarship applicants who skip the entrance exam (exam is remote, so he can take it). Approval does not guarantee a scholarship. Sources: MRE PEC-PG selection process page; UNICAMP FEM PSE 2026-1S call (English PDF).
